summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of the 4 recent improvements + regression. All 29 assertions passed (100%). Hero has NO founder photo, correct headline 'Creative Designs That Build Powerful Brands', both CTAs present. About section shows 'Meet the Creative Mind Behind Design World' heading, /founder.webp loads (naturalWidth=2000), glassmorphism card contains 'Vivekanand Garje', 'Founder & Creative Graphic Designer', 'Design World', and 'Kharghar, Navi Mumbai'. Portfolio renders 9 project cards all with images loaded (0 broken), filters return correct counts (Branding=3, Packaging=3, Print Design=2, Social Media=1). Contact form WhatsApp flow verified by intercepting window.open: URL is https://wa.me/919322994747?text=... properly URL-encoded (%20, %0A, %2C etc); decoded text matches EXACTLY the required structure — starts with 'Hi Vivek,', includes the intro sentence, and labeled sections 'My Name:', 'My Email:', 'My Phone:', 'Project Details:' followed by the submitted values. Empty-form submission now correctly displays the sonner 'Missing Information' toast (previous iteration bug is fixed). Floating WhatsApp button becomes visible on scroll and links to wa.me/919322994747.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx phone input has no data-testid — testable only via input[type='tel']. Consider adding data-testid='contact-phone-input' for consistency.
Hero.jsx still calls useTransform at top-level (fine) but the WhatsApp CTA href uses a plain string with unencoded apostrophe in query — browsers tolerate it, but encodeURIComponent would be safer.
Portfolio filter test note: 'Print Design' category has 2 items (Haven Marketing Brochure + Echo Fest Poster & Banner), not 1 — matches Portfolio.jsx array.
Logo issue from iteration_1 not re-tested here (out of scope for this iteration's improvements) but should be verified by main agent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 recent improvements verified: (1) Hero clean layout no founder photo, (2) About glassmorphism card + founder photo, (3) Portfolio 9 AI mockups load correctly with working filters, (4) Contact form WhatsApp URL exact format confirmed via window.open interception. Sonner toast wiring is now fixed. If retesting, use the same window.open interception pattern in Contact test — do not navigate away.
